note: Decodable word bank. 'graphemes' lists grapheme ids from phonics/graphemes.json in reading order; split digraphs (a_e etc.) sit where the vowel sound is heard. A word may only be used at a child's level once every grapheme's group is unlocked (decodableFromGroup). Rhyme families share 'rime', a family key by sound: where one spelling has two sounds the key names the second (owl/cow are 'owl'/'ow'; bowl and snow are 'owl-oa'/'ow-oa'; wood is 'ood-short'). Every picturable word needs pic_<word> artwork and every word needs word_<word> audio.
